name: list_error_clusters
description: Cluster recent captured errors by fingerprint to see which error classes are recurring and how often across the org — the triage overview. Prefer this over reading raw errors when you want the SHAPE of what's failing platform-wide. Anti-trigger: to diagnose ONE specific failed execution (failing step, stack, suspect files) use agent.debug.trace; this is the fleet-wide histogram, not a single-run frame.

fingerprint.description: Stable grouping key (SHA-256 of error_class + normalized message)

sampleMessage.description: Bounded sample message from the most recent occurrence

source.description: Server runtime that captured the error (api|app|mcp|inngest|runner)

count.description: Occurrences of this fingerprint within the window

firstSeen.description: Earliest occurrence timestamp within the window

lastSeen.description: Latest occurrence timestamp within the window

clusters.description: Error classes ranked by occurrence count, highest first

totalErrors.description: Total error occurrences in the window (across all clusters, not just the returned page)

distinctClusters.description: Total distinct fingerprints in the window (may exceed `clusters.length` when truncated)

truncated.description: True when distinctClusters exceeds the returned `limit`

sinceHours.description: Effective lookback window in hours actually applied
